articles.title: The Marvel Role Rachel McAdams Turned Down
articles.summary: Before Gwyneth Paltrow played Pepper Potts, Marvel offered the Iron Man role to Rachel McAdams. She said no, took a break, and joined Marvel years later in Doctor Strange.

articles.title: A Movie Credit So Rare, Hollywood Barely Uses It
articles.summary: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping carries an Adaptation by Suzanne Collins credit, a movie credit so rare the Writers Guild only allows it in special cases.

articles.title: From Flop to $48 Million: The Little Film That Could
articles.summary: Hanuman Ansh, a spiritual drama made for $180,000 and written off as a flop, has earned $48 million thanks to word of mouth and fans who traveled cinema to cinema.
